# FG-DEPLOY-0012

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`deploy`](../../ops/runbooks/deploy.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_running_deployment_without_heartbeat_is_abandoned` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: デプロイの実行が途中で止まりました。環境の状態を確かめる必要があります。管理者に問い合わせ番号を伝えてください。
- en: The deployment stopped part way. The state of the environment needs to be checked. Give the request ID to the administrator.
- id: Deployment berhenti di tengah jalan. Kondisi lingkungan perlu diperiksa. Berikan ID permintaan kepada administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 review: a deployment was `running` but its worker stopped sending heartbeats (the worker process stopped or crashed, or could not record the end in the database). The sweep of `deploy_runner` (at every pass, so also when a worker starts) ended it `failed` with this code and an audit row; it never rolls back by itself: what the targets run is unknown.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs `forge.deploy.abandoned` (error) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `deployment_id`, `project_id`, `environment`. Read: SELECT id, status, sha, previous_sha, started_at, heartbeat_at FROM forge.deployments WHERE id = <deployment_id>; and the worker log around heartbeat_at (`forge.deploy.finish_failed`, a crash).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook deploy (Abandoned deployment): check on each target what version runs (its script log), restore it by hand if needed, then request a known good SHA.
